correctness.rationale: Group averaging over coordinate permutations preserves endpoints and contracts the commutator norm. Diagonal-unitary conjugation makes nonnegative radial edge increments, whose Perron norm is that of an (n+1)-vertex Jacobi matrix with weights sqrt((k+1)(n-k)). For n odd an alternating matching h_even=1/w_even, h_odd=0 achieves L; normalized dual vector u_{2j}=u_{2j+1}=(2L w_{2j})^-1/2 gives the Rayleigh lower bound ||J(h)||>=sum(h)/L by strict log concavity of w. Thus both bounds match in all odd dimensions. Midpoint quadrature after subtraction of endpoint square-root singularities gives pi/2+zeta(1/2,1/2)/sqrt(N)+O(N^-3/2). Independent full-commutator checks confirmed n=1,3,5,7 and Rayleigh certificates; these finite checks do not prove n unbounded.
